Codex, Grok, and Antigr"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"avity log in via OAuth in the dsh web UI (Settings → Subscriptions), while Copilot uses the GitHub O"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"Auth device flow; Claude imports credentials from an existing Claude Code session when there is one "},{"id":"p4s5","text":"(macOS Keychain or `~/.claude/.credentials.json`) and otherwise falls back to the same browser OAuth"},{"id":"p4s6","text":" flow, so the Claude Code CLI is not required. Tokens live at `~/.dsh/plugins/subscriptions/auth.jso"},{"id":"p4s7","text":"n` (mode 0600) and refresh automatically."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Subscription and model display names"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Open **Settings → Subscriptions → Manage** to set a subscription display name, or edit a model's dis"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"play name under **Edit model list**. Both share the existing Save/Cancel actions; clearing a name or"},{"id":"p6s3","text":" choosing Reset to default and saving restores the original name. Names are single-line text of up t"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"o 80 characters, stored per provider and model ID in `provider-settings.json`, and survive restarts "},{"id":"p6s5","text":"and catalog refreshes. They only change presentation: provider IDs, model IDs, reasoning settings, a"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"nd account routing remain unchanged. Existing account aliases continue to work independently."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Subscription display names also label provider groups in the native model picker. Saving a cleared n"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"ame restores the provider's default group title."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Demo"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Settings → **Subscriptions**: per-provider login/logout, no API keys. Claude imports credentials fro"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"m Claude Code when available and otherwise uses OAuth, as Codex and Grok always do (settings screens"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"hots use demo accounts and catalog data):"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Configure visibility, default reasoning effort, and context together in **Edit model list**, with sh"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"ared Save and Cancel actions:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Configure image generation, video generation, and X search per provider. Tool switches apply only to"},{"id":"p11s2","text":" sessions created after saving:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Logged-in providers join the session model picker with their live model catalogs:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Models that advertise reasoning levels get an **Effort** selector in the same menu — Codex models, G"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"rok 4.6 / 4.5, and Copilot's reasoning models (levels and defaults come from each provider's live ca"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"talog, not a hardcoded list; Copilot's `capabilities.supports.reasoning_effort` array is sent as `re"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"asoning_effort` on chat completions and `reasoning.effort` on the Responses wire). Models listing bo"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"th Copilot endpoints (gpt-5.4, gpt-5-mini) normally speak chat completions but reroute to `/response"},{"id":"p13s6","text":"s` when a request combines function tools with an effort — Copilot rejects that combination on the c"},{"id":"p13s7","text":" request combines function tools with an effort — Copilot rejects that combination on the chat wire:"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Codex models whose catalog advertises the fast tier (the codex CLI's fast mode) get a **Speed** togg"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"le in the composer's tool row, next to the model selector — Standard or Fast (`service_tier: priorit"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"y`), per session. The `/fast` slash command offers the same choice as a popup; it errors with an exp"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"lanation when the current model has no fast tier."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Providers"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"| Route    | Subscription      | Models |"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"| `codex`  | ChatGPT Plus/Pro  | live catalog from `chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex/models` |
| `claud"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"e` | Claude Pro/Max    | all models available in your subscription (Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, Fable — sta"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"tic catalog, updated with the plugin) |
| `grok`   | X Premium (xAI)   | live catalog from `api.x.ai"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"/v1/models` (chat models only); reasoning efforts from the Grok CLI catalog (`cli-chat-proxy.grok.co"},{"id":"p18s5","text":"m/v1/models`) |
| `copilot` | GitHub Copilot   | live catalog from `api.githubcopilot.com/models` (c"},{"id":"p18s6","text":"hat models on both wires, with per-model vision flags and reasoning efforts); login uses the OAuth d"},{"id":"p18s7","text":"evice flow (enter the shown code at `github.com/login/device`) |
| `antigravity` | Google Antigravit"},{"id":"p18s8","text":"y | live catalog from Antigravity `v1internal:fetchAvailableModels`; requests use `generateContent` "},{"id":"p18s9","text":"/ `streamGenerateContent` with text, image, streaming reasoning, and tool-call conversion |"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Only logged-in providers appear in the session model picker; the lists above refresh on login/logout"},{"id":"p19s2","text":". Vision-capable models declare `['text', 'image']` input modalities, and image content is translate"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"d to each provider's wire format."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"### DSH compatibility"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"DSH peers use two short ranges with no upper bound: `>=0.2.0-rc.2 || >=0.2.1-0`. The first retains t"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"he minimum supported version; the second admits all `0.2.1` alpha/RC builds under npm/pnpm's default"},{"id":"p23s3","text":" peer matching, avoiding version-mismatch warnings from these five DSH peers for that release line. "},{"id":"p23s4","text":"Maintain one prerelease anchor per supported release line, not an entry for every RC. Development de"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"pendencies remain pinned to `0.2.1-rc.2`."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Harness uses `includePrerelease: true` and admits all versions at or above the minimum, including fu"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"ture prereleases. npm/pnpm default matching admits later stable versions but requires an explicit pr"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"erelease anchor for each new release line (for example, `>=0.2.2-0` for `0.2.2` prereleases). There "},{"id":"p24s4","text":"is no upper bound: future incompatible releases are not blocked, and admission does not guarantee ru"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"ntime compatibility."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"In DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`, the load-time check uses `engines.dsh` when declared; otherwise, every `@deepse"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"ek-ai/dsh` and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peer must match the running DSH version. Prereleases participate"},{"id":"p25s3","text":" in this check. This plugin does not declare `engines.dsh`, so its DSH peer ranges determine whether"},{"id":"p25s4","text":" it can load. The `@deepseek-ai/cordis` and `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` peers affect package-manager "},{"id":"p25s5","text":"dependency resolution, not this load-time check. They keep their `^4.0.1` / `^3.18.1` floors and als"},{"id":"p25s6","text":"o list the `4.0.5-alpha` / `3.18.5-alpha` builds bundled with DSH `0.2.1-alpha.2` and `0.2.1-alpha.3"},{"id":"p25s7","text":"`, because those caret ranges exclude these prereleases under npm's default semver rules."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"DSH `0.1.x` is no longer supported. Users on that line must upgrade to a supported DSH version or re"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"tain an older compatible plugin release."}],"truncated":true}
